items.title: Public Suffix List refreshed to the current upstream snapshot
items.body: The vendored Mozilla Public Suffix List is updated to the current upstream snapshot, so organizational-domain derivation reflects the current registry delegations everywhere the framework draws a registrable-domain boundary -- DMARC identifier alignment, BIMI issuer scoping, cookie-scope confinement, and same-site policy. The precise upstream commit and version are recorded in the signed data file and the vendor manifest. The .data.js carrier is regenerated and re-signed across all four integrity layers (SHA-256 + SHA3-512 + SLH-DSA-SHAKE-256f signature + in-payload canary), the manifest hashes are refreshed, and the NOTICE attribution date is updated.
